column4: Leo jumping high in the air with both arms up, knees bent, on the grass in a park.
At night, Ella looks out of her bedroom window and points at a big bright full moon in the starry sky.
Leo sitting on a small wooden chair, feet dangling, hands on his knees, smiling.
Ella and Mom baking a cake in the kitchen: Ella stirs batter in a big bowl, a finished cake on the table.
Leo cooking an egg in a frying pan on the stove with Dad helping beside him, Leo wearing a little apron.
Ella climbing a tree in the park, holding a branch, one foot on a lower branch.
Ella dancing with Mom in the living room, holding hands and twirling, both laughing.
Mia playing with a red ball in the garden, bouncing it, very happy.
Leo running fast across a park, arms swinging.
Leo and Mia playing together on a seesaw in a playground, both laughing.
A kind smiling Taiwanese grandpa with grey hair and glasses, wearing a brown cardigan, sitting on a park bench and waving.
Two little Taiwanese sisters, a 7-year-old and a 4-year-old, wearing matching yellow dresses, holding hands and smiling.
A ginger cat curled up sleeping on a cushion, eyes closed, peaceful. No people.
Dad standing in the living room, smiling and waving hello.
Mom standing in the kitchen doorway, smiling warmly, holding a cup of tea.
Two little Taiwanese brothers, a 7-year-old and a 4-year-old, wearing matching blue striped T-shirts, arms around each other, smiling.
